acceptance: pr-arm ends with one explicit line stating armed, refused (with the reason) or waiting
A test pins the final line for the armed and refused cases
context: Seen repeatedly while arming pull requests 3569, 3582 and 3599: the last line of output was the duration message even when auto-merge had been enabled.
description: make pr-arm prints 'verify-fast-duration verdict for <sha> is pass; arming is not held' and then either arms or refuses with a separate line. The wording reads as if arming did not happen, when it means the duration verdict does not hold arming. Operators and agents misread the output while polling.
